title: Retailer best practices for AI-powered Performance Max campaigns - Google Ads Help - Accelerate with Google US

facts.fact: Google states that during the 2022 holiday season, 55% of shoppers used five or more channels, ranging from video to social media, to shop over a two-day period.
facts.quote: During the 2022 holiday season, 55% of shoppers used five or more channels, ranging from video to social media, to shop over a two-day period.

facts.fact: Google states that advertisers who shifted from Standard Shopping campaigns to Performance Max drove a 25% increase in conversion value on average at a similar ROAS.
facts.quote: Advertisers that have shifted from Standard Shopping campaigns to Performance Max drove a 25% increase in conversion value, on average, at a similar ROAS.

facts.fact: Google says Performance Max, powered by Google AI, runs across Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, and Google Maps inventory.
facts.quote: Powered by Google AI, Performance Max helps retailers increase sales and optimize ROI across all Google Ads channels and inventory—including Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, and Google Maps.
